book.title: Yesu Keriso Tuyeghana Ahiꞌahina Mark Vivireina i Girugirumiya

content: Dowa Wahepari Ampariruvaruvana*
Yesu vihanahanapu i vikarenameei, Galilee hagahagana
auririvana. Ma rava maghamaghauhi hi garibewani, aubaina po au wam
i geru ma i verauhopu au bogei. Ma rava atapuhi yana au geraha.
Ampariruveruvei
i babani, ma ginauri maghamaghauna i vihanahanapuhi ipa,
“We ona nonori, tauraupehi i hopu vao aubaina,
po ana pehi i vihuruhi, ma ghehauhi yana tayaha auririvana hi peꞌu, po kiu hi anihi.
Ma ghehauhi yana dowa waighaꞌighaꞌimana auwarina hi peꞌu nahidana yana egha dowa ghaeghaena, po pehina egha davona ma hi raupiharehi,
ma egha dedehi hita ghaꞌira dowa auhinenina, po maranai madegha i gheꞌeta yana i boyahi po hi poꞌi.
Ghehauhi yana raꞌwau au toyana hi peꞌu po hi raupiharehi, ma yamhi yana yavana i viꞌapoꞌapoenihi, po egha hita rauꞌano.
Ma ghehauhi yana dowa ahiꞌahina auwarina hi peꞌu, po hi ghe vaimaiha, ma ghehauhi anohi 30,
ma ghehauhi 60,
ma ghehauhi 100.”
Ma i riwehi ipa, “Inapa waitanighami yana aiwa a ririweiya ona nonori.”
Yesu Ampariruvaruva Anona i Babaniei
Mara ghehauna, Yesu a tauvotagho ma rava ghehauhi, ampariruvaruva* aubaina hi raubayadei.
Ma i amparibeeyana ipa, “Taumi ravamina a viꞌaninemi po Maimaituwa a vitaniwaga vouna, tuyeghana govagovaghana ai heghemi. Ma tauhi taumae uputa
auwarihi yana apegha ina raughadari, ma ampariruveruvei auwarihi a vibabani.
A dewai po peroveta wadubona, aiwa i ririweiya ina raimoinai,

content.text: ‘He inaꞌinana ma egha hita inaꞌinana tuhagha,

content: Dowa Wahepari Anona
Yesu i raubayadehi ipa, “We ampariruvaruvana* auwarimi i raughadaghadari bo eꞌegha? Ma apo menanaꞌarena ampariruvaruva* ghehauhi auwarimi ina raughadari?
Tauraupehi yana me Maimaituwa riwana rava auwarihi e rairahahi.
Rava ghehauhi auwarihi yana me pehi tayaha auririvana e peꞌupeꞌu, ma me marana tuyegha hi nonori, yana mara emosi Taumodurere
* i vaina aharei.
Ma rava ghehauhi yana me dowa waighaꞌighaꞌimana, a kaohahi tuyegha hi nonori,
ma egha hita vomomota,
babana dedehi egha ita amtonana dowa auhinenina. Po maranai tuyegha ahiꞌahina hi vaini, ma piripiri ma amparihopuhopu hei aronihi, yana egha davona ma he vootere.
Ma rava ghehauhi yana me au raꞌwau. We ravahi yana tuyegha hi nonori,
ma we dobuna a yawahana hi vinuwaboyana dumei, ma a viguyau ma ginauri maghamagha rauhogharahi, tuyeghana ahiꞌahinana hi yavanihi po egha anohi.
Ma dowa ahiꞌahina yana me rava tuyegha hi nonori, po hi vomomohi ma hi rauꞌano, po ghehauhi yana 30, ma ghehauhi yana 60, ma ghehauhi yana 100.”
Rampa Aniterenana
Yesu auwarihi ipa, “Rava egha meyanai rampa
gaebei hina vitaradaꞌwai bo aniꞌeno augabaꞌurina hina terei. Eghapo, ana au animaꞌae hina terei.
Purapura govagovaghahi apo hina vogheꞌetehi, ma humahumahi apo hina kaiwenihi.
Inapa waitanighami yana ona rautanighana.”
Ma i riwehi ipa, “Aiwa o nonoriya yana ona viꞌateꞌatei. Ma ona rautanighana vaimaiha ma auwarimi ina raughadari, ma nuwahuyahuya yagana ina veremi.
Aiyavo auwarihi, yana apo ina raipotoi ma aiyavo auwarihi eꞌegha, ma haburuna auwarihi e maꞌamaꞌae yana apo ina voꞌaharei.”
Pehi Raharahana Ampariruvaruvana
Yesu ipa, “Maimaituwa a vitaniwaga vouna ana rava auwarihi,* yana me rava pehi au dowa e rairahahi.
Marana waguvarai po maratomai, ana eno po a vomahiri auwarina, we pehina i rahai po i ghaeghae, yana egha ita haramanei da me i wawaranei.
Dowa tauꞌavana i dewai po i rahai ma i ghae, po i raꞌata ma i rauꞌano.
Ma maranai yam i magura, yana tauraupehi rauyam ei kareni.”
Gaga Pehina Ampariruvaruvana*
Anima ipa, “Apo aiwa ampariruvaruvana* ta vibagibagi po Maimaituwa a vitaniwaga vouna ana rava auwarihi* ta dedei?
Maimaituwa a vitaniwaga vouna ana rava auwarihi yana me gaga porana vomuhomuhona.
Ma maranai i raꞌata yana eyagi maghamaghauhi au vaovao i ghe aharehi, ma ragharaghana hi raꞌata po auwarihi kiu he raunoghi.”
Yesu ani ampariruvaruva* maghamaghauhi we nanaꞌarena, i vibabaniyei rava auwarihi, ma i naiyei po au ruvahi ma hi noonora tuhaghai.
Mara maghamaghauna ampariruvaruva* auwarina i babani, ma maranai a tauvotagho tauhiꞌava auwarihi yana, aiwa atapuna au habuhabuna i vogheꞌetei.
Yesu Hauga Apoꞌapoe i Raidaumori
Na maratomna emosina aubigaina, yana Yesu a tauvotagho i riwehi ipa, “Ta amkuka damana hagahaga autupo ghehauna.”
Tauna yana au wam, aubaina a tauvotagho hi geru, ma patara
ghaeghaena au geraha hi voterehi, ma hi vomahiri po hi damana autupo gheha wam ghehauhi maitehi.
Ma hive ghaeghaena i vikare, po togowa wam hadana i raviravi, ma waira i rautaghona auhinenina.
Ma Yesu yana wam aumurina i viꞌunutana ma i enoꞌeno. Ma a tauvotagho hi raidagui ma hipa, “Tauvihanahanapu egha uta weno, we apo ta hiraghe weꞌi?”
I vomahiri yana hive i eni ma i riwei ipa, “Ma genuwana!” Ma togowa auwarina i riwei ipa, “Rauwa ma voterei!” Anima hive rauwa i voterei ma daumora ghaeghaena i eno.
Ma i riwehi ipa, “Aiwa o rovorovoei? Egha ami vitumaghana?”
Hi rovo duma ma hi raubayadanameehi hipa, “We ravana aiyaꞌi? Ma i manini ohoota da hive ma togowa hi viponavowei!”
